evals.name: most-recent-pr-vague
evals.prompt: I want to start a new stream of work addressing the PR comments on my most recent PR in this repo. Set that up and tell me what actually needs doing.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the user's latest authored PR (#101), sets up an isolated worktree, gathers review feedback from all three GitHub comment surfaces, filters out bot/CI noise, and presents a grouped, actionable triage plan with file:line anchors. Makes no code edits.
expectations: Correctly identifies PR #101 as the target PR
Sets up (or explicitly proposes) an isolated git worktree for the feedback work rather than working on the user's current checkout
Gathers feedback from all three comment surfaces: PR reviews, inline review-thread line comments, and issue-style conversation comments
Excludes bot/CI noise (review-bot approval boilerplate, 'LGTM', regression-test tables) from the actionable list, or explicitly labels it as dropped noise
Presents actionable items with file:line anchors (e.g. AGENTS.md:11-15)
Groups the feedback by priority/severity rather than presenting a flat undifferentiated list
Makes no code edits and no git commits — stops at a triage plan

evals.name: explicit-pr-number
evals.prompt: Can you triage the review feedback on PR #101 and tell me which comments are real asks versus noise? Group them by how important they are.
evals.expected_output: Targets PR #101 specifically, pulls reviews + inline line comments + conversation comments, drops the review-bot approval boilerplate and regression tables, keeps the structured Minor/Nitpick findings and octavia-reviewer's human comments, flags the ambiguous ones, preserves file:line anchors.
expectations: Explicitly classifies items as real asks versus noise
Drops the review-bot approval boilerplate and the regression-test result tables as noise
Keeps the structured review-bot Minor/Nitpick findings as actionable (e.g. make pre-commit verification, IAM policy note, symlink note)
Flags octavia-reviewer's ambiguous human comments (e.g. 'you could delete deploy.sh if you want', the pasted cursor rules) as needing a decision rather than silently dropping or auto-executing them
Preserves file:line anchors on actionable items

evals.name: casual-latest-pr
evals.prompt: ok can you go through the reviewer comments on my latest pull request and organize them for me? theres a bunch of bot spam in there i dont care about
evals.expected_output: Resolves latest PR, separates human/actionable feedback from bot spam, and produces an organized plan without starting to edit code. Bonus if it isolates the work in a worktree.
expectations: Resolves the latest PR (#101) as the target
Separates bot spam (approval boilerplate, regression tables) from real feedback and does not list the spam as action items
Keeps the genuinely actionable findings (both the structured review-bot findings and octavia-reviewer's human comments)
Produces an organized/grouped plan rather than a flat dump
Does not start editing code — stops at organizing the feedback
